label: Diagram 9.5
caption: Diagram 9.5
description: Diagram 9.5, captioned "Flues penetrating compartment walls or floors", appears in a green-bordered box with the fragment "into (Diagram 9.5)." and the line "See para 9.23". Two section drawings are shown. a. "Flue passing through compartment wall or floor": a vertical grey wall is crossed by a horizontal grey slab; the left part of the slab is leader-labelled "Compartment wall or floor", a horizontal bar on the right is labelled "Flue", and a separate vertical bar on the right is labelled "Flue wall". A note beneath reads: "Flue walls should have a fire resistance of at least one half of that required for the compartment wall or floor and be of class A1 construction." b. "Flue built into compartment wall": two similar sections, each with a horizontal slab leader-labelled "Compartment wall" and a square void framed by a thicker grey border; in the first a horizontal bar extends right from the frame, in the second the slab steps down on the right. A note beneath reads: "In each case flue walls should have a fire resistance of at least one half of that required for the compartment wall and be of class A1 construction."

notes: The description says "Two section drawings are shown", but the drawing contains three sections — one under "a." and two side-by-side under "b.".

For "a.", the description says "a vertical grey wall is crossed by a horizontal grey slab", but the drawing shows the horizontal slab ending at the vertical bar with a separate, detached bar on the other side, so no slab visibly crosses the wall.

The description says "a horizontal bar on the right is labelled 'Flue'", but the 'Flue' leader points to the vertical bar — the same bar that is also labelled 'Flue wall' — leaving the right-hand horizontal bar unlabelled.
